# kineticRouter

> Public documentation and model pricing index.

## Catalog and availability

The current public catalog contains 38 listed models across 8 providers, including 1 deprecated model. Official reference rates use verification dates from 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-30. Display discounts by provider: OpenAI: 80% off; Anthropic: 85% off; Grok: 90% off; DeepSeek: 80% off; Zhipu: 80% off; Moonshot: 80% off; Gemini: 50% off; MiniMax: 90% off. These discounts apply to published input, output, cache, tiered, and image-token components. Deprecated models are marked explicitly instead of displaying a discount badge. Variants without separate official rates use their named base model's rates. The original August 30, 2026 archive is retained separately.

Every active provider uses the OpenAI-compatible https://api.kineticrouter.com/v1 base URL, or https://cdn-api.kineticrouter.com/v1. Use provider/model IDs and a kineticRouter API key. Meta support is planned and has no active catalog entries. Public display prices are separate from actual account billing; the authenticated customer console reports billed usage and account rates.
